vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: web-slides
Version: 2.0.2

The skill bundle is a functional HTML slide generator, but it is classified as suspicious due to the inclusion of scripts like `chrome-utils.mjs` and `render-preview.mjs` that use `execFileSync` to launch a local headless Chrome process. This creates a vulnerability where an AI agent could be coerced via prompt injection to render sensitive local files into images (LFI) by manipulating the input file paths. While this functionality is plausibly needed for the stated purpose of creating slide previews, the execution of external binaries with agent-controlled arguments represents a high-risk capability that lacks explicit sanitization.

llm.summary: The skill is internally consistent with its stated purpose: a local Node-based single-file HTML slide generator that reads its bundled theme/docs and writes HTML/previews — it does not request secrets or remote endpoints.

dimensions.detail: Name/description match the files and scripts: packaged Node scripts produce single-file HTML slides, theme docs, examples, and preview generation. No unnecessary cloud credentials or unrelated binaries are requested.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md instructs the agent to call local Node scripts and read included references/theme files — that is within purpose. The scripts use child_process.execFileSync to invoke node and (optionally) a local Chrome binary to render PNG previews, and they read/write files under the repository (dist/, examples/). This is expected for a generator but does mean the skill will execute local binaries and write files to disk when invoked.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install specification is provided (instruction-only). All code is bundled; nothing is downloaded from external URLs during install. This minimizes supply-chain risk.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill declares no required environment variables or credentials. Scripts optionally read CHROME_BIN/DEFAULT_CHROME to launch a local Chrome for rendering previews — that optional env var is proportional to the preview capability and not required for HTML generation.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always is false and the skill does not attempt to modify other skills or system-wide agent settings. Scripts write outputs to local dist/ paths within the repository, which is expected behavior for a generator.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This package is coherent with being a local HTML slide generator. Before running: 1) If you are cautious, inspect the repository locally (scripts use execFileSync to run node and optionally a local Chrome binary). 2) The generator reads bundled theme/reference files and writes outputs under dist/ — run it in a sandbox or an isolated directory if you don't want files mixed into your system. 3) If you don't want headless Chrome invoked, avoid running render-preview/render-preview-related scripts or unset CHROME_BIN; generate the HTML only via generate-slide-html.mjs. 4) There are no network calls, no required API keys, and no hidden endpoints — but as with any third-party code, run it in a controlled environment and review outputs before sharing publicly.
